Batch BATCH_2026-10-06 (13 converted games, 70 positions) on branch sonnet/positions-fix-2026-10-12 tip 4afb0041. Every error the first panel named in this batch is fixed except one: Chubby Cheer is still dropped. That covers his printings, the 020518 Energy, Oricorio, Brass Rock, Mach Stealth, Prickly Powder, the Wally and Turbo Shark Energy targets, empty and cut-short plans, the 213625 knockout and Stadium, the 032023 discard Energy, 020518 t13 and the Lucky Ice Pop wording.

All 13 deck files match DECK_USED: each has 20 cards, the right Energy type, and every two-printing card is one of each, chosen by what the card does. The script check matched every card name, HP, Energy by type, Tool, point total, opponent hand count, Stadium and owner, and turn count against the ledger in all 70 positions. By hand, every card of his in hand, on the board, under evolutions and in the discard has the right printing. All plans match the ledger.

Remaining issues, from most to least important:
- **Opponent's discard is always 0 (major).** In 003547 and 183108 the opponent's Houndstone does more damage for each Psychic Pokémon in its discard pile. The ledger shows 4 or more there, so the real attack does 130 to 170 damage. The positions show 50. This affects 5 positions.
- **Chubby Cheer is still dropped (minor).** It is not carried and not named in the notes (2 positions).
- **"Not settled" marks are wrong in the safe direction (minor).** 5 positions mark one of his cards as not settled, and their notes say "not told by the ledger". In fact the ledger names the printing in the hand card's own name, and the chosen printing is right.
- **Extra cards under the opponent's Rare Candy evolutions (minor).** A Stage 1 the opponent skipped with Rare Candy is placed under its Stage 2, then listed as an unsettled opponent card (9 positions).
- Small notes: a Poké Ball the opponent took is still in his discard, Hitmonlee is marked unsettled though its attack settles it, two switch-2 table columns still flag cards by name, and the Aegislash plan label does not say which Aegislash.

Only the discard issue is likely to change what a bot does, and only in the 5 Houndstone positions.

verdict.reasoning:
I re-derived the finding from the fixed files, both ledgers, card.py and the engine. It holds: the same 5 positions are affected, and these are the only 5. Three details need correcting; they are listed after the checks.

What holds:
1. All 125 positions in positions_all.json have opp.discard_n 0 and opp.discard_energy []. This is hard-coded in harness/ledger_to_positions.py at line 902. Every position's notes say "his discard is not tracked (0)", but approximate_reason only says "opponent's list unknown". Neither REVIEW_POSITIONS_laptop.md nor PAUSE_GAMES_NEW_READ_sonnet.md mentions it, so it is not an accepted item.
2. card.py, Houndstone B2a 053, [PC] Last Respects: "50 — This attack does 20 more damage for each [P] Pokémon in your discard pile."
   - The engine maps it to ExtraDamagePerPokemonTypeInDiscard, both on the branch and at 8626a35, the engine the harness was built from.
   - In pg_pos.rs (around lines 151-163), with discard_n 0 and no "filler" key, the opponent's discard is empty. So the bot sees 50 at the start of the position.
   - The runner would accept named cards: when discard_n is absent it reads opp.discard as a list. Carrying the discards is feasible.
3. Houndstone B2a 053 is on the opponent's board in exactly these 5 positions:
   - 003547 t09 (Bench, 160 with Elegant Cape), t11 and t13 (Active)
   - 183108 t07 (Bench, 2 Psychic Energy) and t09 (Active, 70 HP)
   - 003547 t07 and 183108 t05 show only Greavard.
4. Game 003547, TURN_LEDGER.json:
   - The opponent's top-of-discard previews in turns[1], [3], [5] and [7], automatic_events_in_order[0].event, are Klefki (T2), Houndstone (T4), Pumpkaboo (T6) and Gourgeist (T8). TURN_EVIDENCE discard_snapshots show the same.
   - Last Respects does 130 at T10 (turns[9].plays_in_order[2]), T12 (turns[11].plays_in_order[2]) and T14 (turns[13].plays_in_order[1]).
   - None of the defenders is weak to Psychic: Wailord B1 057 and Mega Sharpedo ex B4 035 are weak to Lightning. So 130 means 4 Psychic Pokémon.
   - Dustin knocks out nothing between T8 and T14. The real threat is 130 at the start of t09, t11 and t13, against the bot's 50.
5. Game 183108, TURN_LEDGER.json:
   - T4: Soul Shot discards Chingling (turns[3].plays_in_order[5], nested attack_cost_discard).
   - T6: Soul Shot discards a hidden card (turns[5].plays_in_order[1]).
   - T7: Dustin knocks out Gourgeist, which had Pumpkaboo under it (turns[6].plays_in_order[2] and automatic_events_in_order[0]).
   - Damage130 at T8 (turns[7].plays_in_order[2]). Mega Sableye ex B3b 041 is weak to Grass, so 130 means 4 Psychic Pokémon, and the hidden T6 card must have been one.
   - Damage170 at T10 (turns[9].plays_in_order[2]) comes after Dustin knocks out the first Houndstone at T9, which adds Houndstone and Greavard: 6 Psychic Pokémon.

Corrections:
(a) 183108 t07 is overstated. That position is the start of Dustin's turn 7, before his Gourgeist knock-out. The real discard then holds 2 Psychic Pokémon (Chingling plus the inferred T6 card), so Last Respects is 90, not 130.
   - If the bot plays Dustin's line (knocks out Gourgeist), the engine discards Gourgeist and Pumpkaboo itself and shows 90 against the real 130. The gap is 40 on any line, not 80.
   - The decision effect at t07 is weak. Mega Sableye ex, his only Pokémon, has 170 HP and survives both 130 and 90.
   - For 183108 t09, the "170" is after Dustin's own knock-out. The engine would show 90 on that line. At the start of t09 the threat is 130 against 50.
(b) Wording: card.py says "your discard pile", meaning the Houndstone owner's own pile. It does not say "the opponent's discard pile". In the position's terms that is opp.discard, so the conclusion stands.
(c) Two inferences rest on damage arithmetic, not on the ledger naming the cards:
   - Klefki has a Metal printing (A3 121) and a Psychic one (B1 120). Only the 130 shows it was the Psychic one; the identity_limit calls the four discards Psychic.
   - For the hidden T6 card, the ledger says "Identity not readable; do not infer from Last Respects later." If only the named cards are carried, Last Respects comes out at 110 instead of 130 in 183108 t09, and 70 instead of 90 in t07. Carrying the named discards fixes 003547 completely. In 183108 it still leaves a 20-damage gap unless that inference is accepted; otherwise those 2 positions need marking approximate for this reason.

Material decision effects:
- 003547 t09: the real 130 knocks out the 100-HP Wailord (40, plus 40 from Irida, plus 20 from Soothing Shore); 50 does not.
- 003547 t13: after Cyrus, the real 130 knocks out the benched Mega Sharpedo ex (60, healed to 80 by Soothing Shore), which loses the game; 50 does not.
- 183108 t09: the real 130 knocks out Mega Sableye ex at 40-80 HP; 50 knocks it out only at 40, before any heal.

Other cards with the same root cause: I looked up all 96 opponent board cards across the 125 positions with card.py. The only other one that reads its owner's discard is Dragonair B4 117 (Dragon's Blessing) in 003458 t05, t07 and t09. It cannot be used there: at t05 Pichu is Active and there is no Active Dragon, and at t07 and t09 Dragonair is under Dragonite. The count stays at 5.

- 20261006_012927000_iOS/TURN_LEDGER.json, turn_number 9. plays_in_order order 6 has kind attack, card_name "Chubby Cheer", result "10 damage (150→140) and +20 opponent attack damage next opponent turn." The turn 10 board_at_start and board_after (opponent.active.active_effects) both list Chubby Cheer. Turn 11 confirms it was applied: the Cynthia play reads "prior Chubby Cheer +20 still applies", and Land Crush reads "120+20+50=190 damage".

Fixed positions (/home/dacz8976/posfix_review/rl/results/pause_games_new_2026-10-12/positions_all.json):
- KW-261005_034953000-t14 (turn_count 14, usable true) has turn_effects [] and no 'effects' on any board entry.

- Line 903 hard-codes 'turn_effects': [].
- EFFECT_TEXTS (lines 372-379) holds only Brass Rock, Pile-Driving Hammer and Prickly Powder.
- The fallback note at line 423 fires only on text starting "During your opponent's next turn" or containing "lasts until". Chubby Cheer's text starts "During your next turn", so it gets no carried effect and no note.

Engine (posfix_review checkout):
- effect_mechanic_map.rs 2522-2528 maps this exact text to Mechanic::IncreasedDamageNextTurn{amount 20, energy_type None}.
- apply_attack_action.rs 1915-1929 calls add_turn_effect(TurnEffect::IncreasedDamageForPlayer{amount, player: actor, energy_type}, 2).
- state/mod.rs 1063-1077 shows that add_turn_effect with duration 2 on turn T adds the effect to turns T, T+1 and T+2.
- hooks/core.rs 1051-1060 applies it only when player == attacking_player and the attack is Active to Active.
- TurnEffect derives Serialize/Deserialize with no serde attributes, so it is externally tagged: {"IncreasedDamageForPlayer": {"amount": 20, "player": 1, "energy_type": null}}.

(a) The CONVERTER_FIX sentence (Major: effects row) literally covers only "During your opponent's next turn" and "lasts until" texts, so as worded it is not false. Its implied claim that every carried effect is handled or noted is what fails.
(b) Matching the engine exactly would put the entry at both turn_count and turn_count+1 (14 and 15; 10 and 11). Only turn_count+1 has an effect, because the buff is bound to player 1 and his own turn's attacks are player 0's. The proposed fix (turn_count+1, player 1, energy_type null) is therefore sufficient.
